scope: All generated Lua documentation files in pinned source trees; source presence and lexical mention only, not in-client availability or documentation correctness.
matching: Functions: full namespace.member token, globals: exact unqualified identifier (excluding preceding dot/colon), events: LiteralName. Script methods: any :member or .member token (weak and object-agnostic). Corpus: maintained wow-* skill Markdown, excluding generated package and audit reports.
